label: Does existence never belonging to an essence apply at an esse-essence identity? (B6 crux)
summary: #1887 next slice 1, God-existence stage; note docs/notes/existence-in-essence-identity.md, repaired after the independent semantic challenge of head 2ce14478 (6 P1, several P2, all accepted; disposition table s.13). Analyst formulations, attribution deferred; read: ST I q.2 a.1 and q.3 a.4 with ad 2 (New Advent), De ente c.4 (Miller), Kant CPR Transcendental Dialectic II.III.IV including the triangle and annihilation paragraphs and note 67 (Meiklejohn, Gutenberg 4280), Hume Dialogues IX (Cleanthes; Gutenberg 4583), SEP Existence, Essential vs. Accidental Properties s.1.1 (authors' own arguments) and s.3, Possibilism-Actualism s.4.1.1 and s.4.2.1. Senses of 'existence belongs to an essence' registered as EXISTENCE_IN_ESSENCE (disambiguation f704b7ca): _1 conceptual containment (concepts as values of their own type ConceptRelation), _2 essential truth (ESSENCE_5, unconditional), _3 act identity (ESSENCE_3 maps), _4 the existing OwnEssentialExistence, _5 consequential essential truth. New primitives: conceptual content (DEF 16c40fbe) and esse exercised at a point (DEF 25d4df96, WORLD_RELATIVE_EXISTENCE_METAPHYSICAL_ESSE_NECESSITY_6, with parameter tags). Results: ca973127 derives the unconditional bridge 565ccd6c from the act-fact link 3a2af70f and exercise in the nature 823d4312 (propext/funext; each needed); law 15 proves the converse, so given the link the two are equivalent (a restatement at the act level, not a narrowing); 63ac77e7 gives the 'possibly absent' verdict fe8c3a1d from Kant's conceptual thesis 9014eea0, concept adequacy effbb158, the essentialist account and unrequired-by-others (each needed; nonvacuous); controls 037bfce4 with 15 laws and models with distinct esse principles: kantAquinas (Kant's thesis and conditional conceptual necessity for a concept from effects, identity, exercise in the nature, essential existence and necessity of the first being, with a second being caused by it in its esse and contingent; the thesis blocks the identity only through concept adequacy or the identity-to-concept bridge; not a model of Thomism as a whole), conditionalIdentity (identity with the act-fact link, EC, a Kantian adequate concept and contingency jointly satisfiable), four Kant-adequacy and two factorization omission models. Law 5: identifying represented with real possibility suffices for real absence; some bridge is needed. Law 6: EC, the link and exercise in the nature are jointly inconsistent at a representably absent identity being, no member selected. Law 11: within essentialism an actual being's nature entails its existence iff it is necessary. Law 12: serious-actualist essences with essence grounds necessity and a nonempty nature give necessity. Laws 13-14: Kant's triangle paragraph (conditional conceptual necessity) gives EC with adequacy, and Kant's thesis at representably absent beings. Equivocation check: 565ccd6c passes from esse as act to existence as fact through the explicit act-fact link, satisfiable with each bundle and unobjected among views accepting an act of being; the quantifier view makes it false or trivial.
blocker: No premise is established. The B6 crux is exercise in the nature (AN, 823d4312), equivalently 565ccd6c given the act-fact link: no motivation for it was identified that does not run through the power/potency account (the 'pure act has no potency' consideration supports the necessity verdict, a shared dependency with PGP/C2) or merely remove the De ente defeater; symmetrically, no motivation for existence-conditional essences at the identity case was identified that does not presuppose the being's contingency (serious actualism, law 11), rest on a concept-adequacy bridge that Kant's four arguments (positing, thalers, annihilation, triangle) do not establish at an act-essence, repeat the unresolved conceivability argument or an unintelligibility claim resting on the same calibration question (Cleanthes), or deny the identity's intelligibility instead (Frege/Russell); Fine's reported objection is neutral at the identity. The factorization treats essential truth as intensional over world-propositions; under Fine's hyperintensional reading it needs a further substitution premise. Next tests: whether the conditional form of an act-essence is coherent by EC's own standards; a hyperintensional essence theory giving EC a principled reason at act-essences; a substitution premise for the act-fact link inside the nature with a model where it fails; the act-of-being dispute (Kenny versus Gilson/Klima, navigation only), which bears on the identity clause of FoundationalAt itself.

current_assessment.scope: The B6 crux at a being with esse = essence (the foundational case of #1889): whether 'existence never belongs to an essence' makes the identity modally idle (ModalGrounding laws 3-4, EC 857654fe), or the identity puts existence in the nature (565ccd6c, f9b26559). Matching scope as in #1888 s.6; the general-theory comparison beyond this case is not in scope.
current_assessment.assessment: The Kant-type thesis does not apply to the identity on any assessed motivation without a bridge or a presupposition: in the conceptual sense (with conditional conceptual necessity) it is consistent with identity, essential existence and necessity, and reaches the identity only through concept adequacy for a Kantian concept, which none of Kant's four arguments establishes at an act-essence without the premise that every essence is a content of predicates; in the essential-truth sense (EC) its motivations presuppose contingency at the case, are the unresolved conceivability argument or an unintelligibility claim on the same question, or deny the identity's intelligibility; Fine is neutral. This meets #1888's toward-PGP condition (d) as stated without standing change: #1888 already scored EC's cut as unmotivated, and PGP's standing needs toward-PGP (a), unmet. Conversely the identity does not give essential existence by itself: the step needs exercise in the nature, equivalent to 565ccd6c given the act-fact link, whose identified support runs through the power/potency route or removes a defeater. Within essentialism the dispute is the modal verdict (law 11). Parity at the foundational being stands; the factorization relocates the crux to the act level without narrowing it. Nothing is established; no formal status changes beyond the computed delta.
current_assessment.next_test: Test whether the conditional form 'if x exists, its act of being is exercised' states the nature of an act-essence by EC's own standards, and whether a hyperintensional essence theory supplies EC a principled reason at act-essences; add a substitution premise for the act-fact link inside the nature with a model where it fails.
